Subject: 20% off our toughest pack — this Sunday only
Preview: The Cascade 45L is built for the trail. Grab 20% off before Sunday.
Body: Your next trip deserves our toughest pack.

The Northbay Cascade 45L is our toughest pack — 45 liters of capacity, an internal frame, and a water-resistant ripstop nylon shell, all at 1.4 kg. It carries what you need without slowing you down.

The Cascade is water-resistant, not waterproof — bring a rain cover for sustained downpours. The ripstop nylon shell handles the everyday abuse of trail and bush. The internal frame keeps the load close to your back over long miles.

This weekend only: take 20% off the Cascade 45L. Offer ends Sunday.
